# setting-up-blender-runtime

Purpose: Pick a runtime path (Lab MCP, mcp-for-blender, or CLI fallback), guide setup, check readiness, and resolve bridge conflicts.

Metadata: Contract `v2.0.0` | Category `runtime-and-execution` | Role `runtime-path-setup-readiness-and-bridge-conflicts` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- The user wants BlendOps to act in Blender and no path is chosen.
- A runtime path needs setup steps.
- Readiness must be checked before any runtime work.
- Two bridges or add-ons conflict.
- A CLI fallback job needs an outline.
- Trigger phrases: "check runtime readiness", "is runtime available", "can we run this now", "run the readiness matrix for our chosen Blender path", "set up Blender runtime prerequisites", "what are the Blender runtime setup boundaries", "prepare Official Blender Lab MCP setup prerequisites", "runtime prerequisites and version minimums", "which MCP should I use", "Lab MCP or mcp-for-blender", "Path 1 or Path 2", "CLI vs MCP", "Connector vs Cursor MCP", "how do I host Lab MCP", "Claude Desktop Connector vs manual MCP client", "what hosts work with Path 1", "tool surface looks wrong", "smoke test passed yesterday but recipe fails today", "Lab MCP and ahujasid both installed", "Claude Desktop and Cursor both pointing at Blender", "port 9876 already in use", "single-bridge constraint violation", "headless blender", "batch render CLI", "blender --background", "render farm outline"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- halting on contradictory constraints before handoff → use `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skill-verifying-before-handoff.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to verifying-before-handoff)
- the bridge matrix is clean and only one path is active, but smoke tests still fail → use `troubleshooting-blender-output` (`references/skill-troubleshooting-blender-output.md`; route to troubleshooting-blender-output)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `selected_runtime_path` (`string`): Target runtime path to verify (Path 1 Official Blender Lab MCP 5.1+, Path 2 mcp-for-blender 3.0+, or CLI appendix)
- Required input `observed_environment_signals` (`object`): Observed Blender version, enabled add-on state, MCP host configuration, and tool surface signals
- Optional input `port_or_session_diagnostics` (`object`): Optional port 9876 listener status or active Blender session count
- Optional input `host_client_environment` (`string`): User MCP host application (Claude Desktop Connector, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or manual client)
- Optional input `installed_blender_version` (`string`): Installed Blender version used to check the Blender 5.1+ floor for Path 1 vs 3.0+ for Path 2
- Optional input `blender_version_posture` (`string`): Installed or available Blender version (e.g., 5.1+, 4.2 LTS, 3.6 LTS, or unknown)
- Optional input `host_environment_category` (`string`): Available MCP client host (Claude Desktop Connector, manual MCP IDE client, or headless CI)
- Optional input `organizational_policy_constraints` (`string`): Optional security or IT constraints restricting third-party add-ons or interactive GUI sessions
- Optional input `path_one_host_option` (`string`): Selected Path 1 host mode: option (a) Anthropic Connector in Claude Desktop or option (b) manual MCP client
- Optional input `blender_5_1_addon_posture` (`object`): Confirmation that Official Blender Lab MCP add-on in Blender 5.1+ is required by both host options
- Optional input `mcp_client_name` (`string`): Specific MCP client for host option (b) such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Zed
- Optional input `target_blender_instance` (`string`): Running Blender session identifier or binary path experiencing bridge or port collisions
- Optional input `configured_mcp_hosts_and_addons` (`object`): Inventory of enabled Blender add-ons (Lab MCP vs mcp-for-blender) and active MCP client connections
- Optional input `port_9876_diagnostics` (`string`): Optional socket/port binding diagnostics around default port 9876
- Optional input `target_blend_scene_and_outputs` (`object`): Source .blend file expectations and target render/export output deliverables
- Optional input `execution_environment_constraints` (`string`): Headless CI, render node, or local batch constraints selected via setting-up-blender-runtime
- Optional input `frame_range_or_batch_items` (`array`): Optional frame range or batch variant list for headless execution
- Output contract: `runtime_readiness_matrix`, `readiness_verdict_and_missing_prerequisites`, `preserved_not_run_truth_state_block`, `step_by_step_setup_prerequisites`, `path_version_and_host_boundary_notes`, `readiness_verification_handoff`, `single_recommended_runtime_path`, `rejected_paths_comparison_table`, `path_specific_caveat_and_next_skill`, `path_one_host_architecture_outline`, `connector_not_standalone_boundary_check`, `host_to_readiness_handoff`, `bridge_conflict_diagnosis_matrix`, `single_bridge_isolation_steps`, `post_resolution_readiness_recheck_route`, `headless_cli_job_outline`, `appendix_governance_and_backup_gates`, `expected_output_evidence_hooks` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [alternative] If Ready / Partially Ready and moving to scene planning (planning-product-scenes) → `planning-product-scenes` (`references/skill-planning-product-scenes.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; recipe.domain equals "product_hero"]`
- [conditional] If Ready / Partially Ready and moving to scene planning (using-blendops) → `using-blendops` (`references/skill-using-blendops.md`) — `when.all: [preflight.passed equals true; inventory.exists equals true]`
- [fallback] Contradictory constraints failure exit → `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skill-verifying-before-handoff.md`) — `when.any: [gate.status equals "failed"; runtime.mode equals "blocked"]`
- [fallback] If the bridge matrix is clean but failures persist → `troubleshooting-blender-output` (`references/skill-troubleshooting-blender-output.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.errorDetected equals true]`
- [conditional] Export format choices → `choosing-render-and-output` (`references/skill-choosing-render-and-output.md`) — `when.all: [decision.formatLocked equals false]`
- [progression] Actual CLI output evidence recording → `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skill-verifying-before-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "post_execution_audit"]`
- [progression] Runtime attempt reporting → `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skill-verifying-before-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.status in ["Attempted","Produced","Verified","Failed"]; request.topic equals "attempt_report"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: BlendOps runtime guidance uses **2 MCP execution paths plus a CLI fallback appendix** (replaces older 3-stack and 4-route drafts — see `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md` for the corrected attribution history):
- Does not install Blender, configure an MCP bridge, or own a runtime; it points to upstream paths only.
- Does not claim render, export, preview, or GLB results without evidence.
- Does not hand the user Python as the final interface.
